transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I came in because I've started doing some things that... just don't make a lot of sense. Mostly at work and school. Like, I'll catch myself lining up receipts all across the floor, or I'll just sit there tapping the calculator in sets of nine. And sometimes I'll just stand by the copier with my hands held up until someone comes over and asks if I'm okay. It's just... strange, and I don't really know why I'm doing it.

When you are doing these things, like tapping the calculator or standing by the copier, do you feel an internal urge to do them to prevent something bad from happening, or do you feel like these actions are being controlled by something outside of yourself?

I don't really know. It's not like I'm worried something bad will happen if I don't do it. I just... do it. I don't feel like someone else is controlling me, either. It's just me doing these weird things, and I can't really explain why.
Do you feel like you want to stop these actions, or do they feel natural or even necessary for you to perform in the moment?

I don't really feel like I want to stop them when I'm doing them, no. In the moment, it doesn't feel necessary, exactly, but it doesn't feel wrong either. It's just... what I'm doing right then. It's only later, when I think about it, or when someone asks me if I'm okay, that I realize how weird it is and wish I hadn't done it.
Have you ever had the experience of hearing voices or seeing things that other people around you cannot see or hear?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... sometimes when I'm just sitting alone at my desk, or, like, walking home from class, I'll hear a voice. It's a man's voice. He'll say things to me like, uh, "check line seven" or "you missed the sign." It sounds really clear. It's clear enough that I always end up looking around to see who said it, but... there's never anybody actually there.
Do you have any personal theories or beliefs about who this man is or why he is giving you these specific instructions?

I don't really know exactly who the voice is, but... well, I know it sounds strange, but I get convinced that it has to do with the numbers at work. Like, certain invoice totals, account numbers, and due dates... I start believing they are messages about me. Even when my supervisor sits down and shows me they are just normal entries, I still feel like they are tracking me, like they're checking whether I understand the pattern. So when the voice tells me to check a line, I feel like it's connected to those messages.

Aside from hearing this voice and feeling like the numbers are messages, have you noticed any changes in your ability to express your thoughts clearly, or have people told you that your speech has become hard to follow lately?

Yeah, actually, people have been telling me that lately. Like at work... if I try to explain why a ledger is off, my thoughts just kind of jump all over the place. I'll start out talking about the account, but then I'm suddenly talking about tuition deadlines, and then tax rules, and then... I don't know, studio lighting and those number patterns I mentioned. 

To me, it feels like it all makes sense in my head, but my coworkers tell me they just can't follow me. They say they have no idea how I got from one point to the next. So, yeah, I guess it has gotten hard for people to understand what I'm trying to say.
About how long have you been experiencing these voices and these thoughts about the numbers?
Um, I'd say both the voices and that feeling about the numbers... they've been happening for about eight months now.
